items.title: Hacker Uses Claude and ChatGPT to Breach Multiple Government Agencies
items.description: A single threat actor compromised nine Mexican government agencies and stole hundreds of millions of citizen records in a highly sophisticated cyberattack. The campaign, which ran from late December 2025 through mid-February 2026, highlights a dangerous shift in the modern threat landscape.
